name: Number-place grid
summary: Fill a 9x9 grid so every row, column and box has the digits 1–9 once.
core_loop: pick a cell → enter a digit → conflicts highlight → fill the grid
rules: each digit once per row, column and 3x3 box
social_hooks: daily grid with friends' solve times
example_prompts: sudoku but with emojis instead of numbers

name: Mini number grid
summary: A small 4x4 or 6x6 number-place puzzle for quick sessions.
core_loop: tap a cell → place a number → finish the small grid
rules: no repeats in rows, columns or regions

name: Queens on colored regions
summary: Place one queen per row, column and colored region with no two touching.
core_loop: place a queen → mark impossible cells → satisfy all regions
rules: one per row, column and region
example_prompts: place one crown per color region

name: Picture logic grid
summary: Use row and column number clues to fill cells and reveal a hidden picture.
core_loop: read clues → fill or cross cells → the picture forms
rules: each number is a run of filled cells in order
social_hooks: make a picture of your pet for a friend to solve

name: Who-owns-what logic grid
summary: Use clues to match people to houses, pets and drinks in a cross grid.
core_loop: read a clue → mark yes or no in the grid → deduce → fill every match
rules: each attribute matches exactly one person

name: Lights out
summary: Tapping a light toggles it and its neighbors; turn them all off.
core_loop: tap a light → it and its neighbors flip → plan → all off
rules: each tap flips a plus shape
example_prompts: turn off all the lights game

name: Fifteen puzzle
summary: Slide numbered tiles into the empty space until they're in order.
core_loop: slide a tile → work row by row → order every tile
rules: only tiles next to the gap move
social_hooks: turn a friend's photo into the puzzle
example_prompts: slide puzzle of our group pic

name: River crossing
summary: Ferry characters across a river without leaving a forbidden pair alone.
core_loop: pick who rides → cross → check pairs → finish
rules: forbidden pairs can't be left alone

name: Move the tower
summary: Move a stack of disks to another peg, never putting a bigger disk on a smaller one.
core_loop: pick a disk → move it → never bigger on smaller → move the whole tower

name: Connect the islands
summary: Connect numbered islands with bridges so each has its number of bridges and all connect.
core_loop: draw a bridge → islands count up → no crossings → everything connects
rules: bridges are straight and don't cross
at most two between a pair

name: Draw the loop
summary: Draw one loop along grid edges; numbers say how many sides of each cell it uses.
core_loop: draw edges → match numbers → close one loop
rules: a single loop with no branches
example_prompts: draw one loop through the grid

name: Light the room
summary: Place bulbs so every cell is lit; numbered walls say how many bulbs touch them.
core_loop: place a bulb → light spreads → no bulbs see each other → light every cell
rules: bulbs light their row and column until a wall
example_prompts: place lamps to light the room

name: Cross sums
summary: Fill white cells with 1–9 so each run adds to its clue, with no repeats in a run.
core_loop: pick a run → choose digits that sum → fill the grid
rules: no repeated digits within a run

name: Cages that add up
summary: Fill a grid where outlined cages must combine to a target with a given operation.
core_loop: read a cage → pick numbers → no repeats in rows or columns → solve
rules: numbers can't repeat in rows or columns

name: Tents and trees
summary: Place one tent next to each tree; tents can't touch; row and column counts must match.
core_loop: place a tent by a tree → match row counts → no touching tents

name: Find the fleet
summary: Deduce where a fleet of ships hides using row and column ship counts.
core_loop: read counts → place ship parts → complete the fleet

name: Two-color grid
summary: Fill a grid with two colors so no three in a row match and rows and columns balance.
core_loop: tap to color → avoid three in a row → balance counts → no duplicate rows
rules: no three of a color in a row
equal colors per row and column

name: Rotate the pipes
summary: Rotate pipe tiles so water flows from the source to every outlet.
core_loop: tap to rotate a tile → connect the flow → no leaks
example_prompts: rotate pipes to connect the water

name: Connect the dots without crossing
summary: Connect pairs of matching dots with paths that fill the whole board and never cross.
core_loop: drag from a dot → reach its pair → fill every cell
win: connect all pairs and fill the board

name: Bounce the laser
summary: Place and rotate mirrors to guide a laser to its target.
core_loop: place mirrors → rotate → fire → hit every target
example_prompts: bounce the beam to the target

name: Unblock the car
summary: Slide cars forward and back to clear a path for the red car.
core_loop: slide a car → open a path → red car exits
rules: cars slide only along their length

name: Push the boxes
summary: Push boxes onto goal squares; boxes can only be pushed, never pulled.
core_loop: move → push a box → don't trap it → every box on a goal
rules: you can push one box at a time, never pull
lose: a box stuck in a corner (undo allowed)
example_prompts: push the crates onto the marks

name: Ice slide maze
summary: Slide across ice until you hit a wall; plan stops to reach the exit.
core_loop: pick a direction → slide until blocked → plan the route → exit
example_prompts: slide until you hit a rock

name: One-stroke drawing
summary: Draw a figure in one continuous line without lifting or retracing an edge.
core_loop: start at a point → trace edges → use every edge once
example_prompts: draw it in one line puzzle

name: Visit every cell
summary: Draw one path from start that visits every cell exactly once.
core_loop: draw from the start → cover every cell → end anywhere
example_prompts: fill the grid with one line

name: Star battle
summary: Place two stars in every row, column and region, never touching.
core_loop: place stars → mark blanks → satisfy all regions
rules: two per row, column and region

name: Shade the duplicates
summary: Shade cells so no number repeats in a row or column, shaded cells don't touch, and unshaded cells connect.
core_loop: shade a cell → check repeats → keep unshaded cells connected
rules: shaded cells can't be side by side

name: Islands and sea
summary: Shade the sea so each number makes an island of that size and the sea is one connected body.
core_loop: grow islands → shade the sea → no 2x2 sea pools
rules: each island has one number equal to its size

name: Tangram
summary: Fit seven geometric pieces together to fill a silhouette.
core_loop: drag a piece → rotate or flip → fill the outline
example_prompts: make the cat shape with tangram pieces

name: Pack the shapes
summary: Fit a set of polyomino pieces into a box with no gaps.
core_loop: pick a piece → rotate → place → fill the box
example_prompts: fit the shapes in the box

name: Move the matchsticks
summary: Move a set number of matchsticks to fix an equation or make a shape.
core_loop: read the goal → move sticks → check
example_prompts: move one match to fix the equation

name: Knight's path
summary: Move a knight so it visits every square exactly once.
core_loop: jump in an L → don't revisit → cover the board

name: Gear train
summary: Place gears so turning the first one turns the last in the right direction.
core_loop: place a gear → mesh teeth → test spin
rules: meshed gears spin in opposite directions

name: Logic gate circuit
summary: Place AND, OR and NOT gates so the outputs light up for the given inputs.
core_loop: place gates → wire inputs → test → all outputs right
rules: each gate follows its truth table

name: Switches in order
summary: Flip switches in the right order; each one changes others by a hidden rule.
core_loop: flip a switch → watch what changes → infer the rule → solve
rules: each switch toggles a fixed set

name: Find the odd one with a scale
summary: Use a balance scale a limited number of times to find the odd weight.
core_loop: pick items → weigh → read tilt → narrow down
example_prompts: find the fake coin with a scale

name: Knights and knaves
summary: Some characters always lie, some always tell the truth; work out who is who.
core_loop: read statements → test cases → assign roles
rules: liars always lie, knights always tell the truth

name: Measure with jugs
summary: Fill, empty and pour between jugs to measure an exact amount.
core_loop: fill or empty → pour → reach the target
rules: jugs have fixed sizes, no markings

name: Flood the board
summary: Change the color of the corner region to grow it until the whole board is one color within a move limit.
core_loop: pick a color → the region grows → fill the board
rules: your region absorbs neighbors of the chosen color
example_prompts: fill the board with one color

name: Number chain
summary: Fill a grid with consecutive numbers so each touches the next.
core_loop: place the next number → keep the chain touching → fill the grid

name: Rotating rings
summary: Rotate rings of tiles to line up a picture or colors.
core_loop: rotate a ring → tiles shift → line up all rings

name: Crack the code
summary: Guess a hidden color or number code; feedback says right-place and right-color counts.
core_loop: guess a code → read feedback → narrow → crack it
rules: feedback counts but doesn't say which
social_hooks: set a code for a friend

name: Mine sweep
summary: Reveal safe cells; numbers count adjacent mines; flag every mine.
core_loop: reveal a cell → read numbers → flag mines → clear the board

name: Follow the arrows
summary: Link cells so each arrow points to the next one in a single path.
core_loop: follow an arrow → pick the next cell → finish the chain
rules: each cell points to the next

name: Complete the symmetry
summary: Fill cells to make the pattern symmetric across the given axis.
core_loop: read the axis → mirror cells → finish
rules: the result must match its reflection

name: Escape the room
summary: Find clues and combine items to open a sequence of locks.
core_loop: search → find a clue → solve a lock → next lock → escape
example_prompts: escape room game for my friends

name: Combination lock riddles
summary: Read riddles to work out each digit of a combination lock.
core_loop: read the riddle → work out a digit → set the lock → open
social_hooks: send a lock to a friend
